title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-jordan-lee-2026-03-04
content:
Release train weekly prep notes - 2026-03-04
Owner: Jordan Lee
Sync: Fri 2026-03-05 10:00am PT (weekly release train go/no-go) - main channel #release-train
Attendees expected: Release leads, SRE, Infra, Product, QA

Agenda (10:00 - 10:45)
- Quick rundowns (10m) - 30s per lead: prod readiness, regressions, infra/capacity
- Go/No-Go checklist review (15m) - call statuses and open blockers
- Rollout plan & smoke test assignments (10m)
- Final comms cadence + rollback criteria (10m)

Quick status (notes from teams)
- Serving runtime: Model v2.1 build passed smoke, two micro-ops regressions in attention kernel - Samir (investigating).
- Infra / capacity: Dedicated pool provisioned for canary, but autoscaler spike test failed at 12k RPS - Aisha (mitigating).
- Console / rollouts: UI toggles ready; feature flags staged in prod-sim - Olivia.
- QA / E2E: Regression suite flagged 4 flaky tests; working on flakes (priority tests green) - QA lead (TBD).

Go / No-Go checklist (call out owner + status)
- [ ] Release notes & external comms drafted (owner: Product / Maya) - STATUS: amber (draft ready, needs legal blurb)
- [x] Core model artifact validated & signed (owner: Applied ML / Priya) - STATUS: green
- [x] Infra provisioning for canary + steady state (owner: Infra / Aisha) - STATUS: green (autoscale follow-up)
- [~] Autoscaler spike handling verified (owner: Infra / Aisha) - STATUS: amber (failed one run at 12k RPS; mitigation: increase warm pool + tweak thresholds)
- [x] DB migrations tested in staging and rollback plan ready (owner: Platform Eng / Luke) - STATUS: green
- [~] Canary smoke tests defined and owners assigned (owner: SRE / Samir) - STATUS: amber (some smoke scripts flaky)
- [x] Observability dashboards & alerts configured (owner: Observability / Evan) - STATUS: green
- [ ] Security & compliance sign-off for Private deployment changes (owner: Security / Priya) - STATUS: red (pending review)
- [x] Customer-facing KB + rollout playbook in docs (owner: Customer Success / Olivia) - STATUS: green

Notes on checklist items:
- Autoscaler: replicate failed spike during today's 11:00 run. Aisha to run 3 additional spike runs pre-sync and share logs. If two or more passes fail, recommend delaying canary by 48 hours.
- Security sign-off: need explicit memo from security that KMS/HSM changes are acceptable for Private customers. Follow-up: Priya to ping security on Slack and ask for ETA by 2026-03-05 EOD.
- Canary smoke: flaky script around kv-cache warmup - suspected timing race. Samir to instrument and add a retry + stronger assertion.

Rollout plan (high level)
1) Canary (50 hosts) in us-west-2 - 15m ramp, smoke tests at +5m and +15m.
2) Increase to 20% traffic over 2 hours with metric guardrails (latency p99, error rate, token cost delta).
3) Full ramp if stable for 3 hours.
4) Rollback criteria: p99 latency > baseline + 100ms for >10m OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR any high-sev customer report.

Smoke test owners & checks
- Infer basic prompt -> check tokens returned & non-empty stream (owner: SRE / Samir)
- End-to-end billing tag propagation (owner: Product / Maya)
- KV cache warmup behavior (owner: Serving Runtime / Samir)
- Latency p50/p95/p99 baseline checks (owner: Observability / Evan)

Action items (assigned)
- Aisha: run 3 autoscaler spike tests and post logs in thread - due 2026-03-04 5pm PT.
- Priya: escalate security sign-off, get memo or at least blocking list - due 2026-03-05 EOD.
- Samir: stabilize smoke script for kv-cache and add retry logic; add instrumentation traces - due 2026-03-04 3pm PT.
- Olivia: finalize KB + one-line customer comms; coordinate with CS to prep priority customer list - due 2026-03-05 10am PT.
- Jordan (me): prepare final go/no-go matrix and slide for sync; bring up rollback comms channel config - due 2026-03-05 9am PT.

Open risks / blockers
- Security/compliance red is the highest blocker for Private deployment customers - cannot ship Private changes without sign-off.
- Autoscaler instability could force narrower canary or slower rollouts, increasing risk of prolonged exposure.
- Flaky smoke tests reduce confidence in canary- must be resolved or we add manual probes.

Notes to self / talking points for sync
- Emphasize that core model is green; infra concerns are the gating factor. Ask infra leads for explicit success criteria (how many consecutive spike runs?).
- Ask security for temporary mitigations (e.g., disable feature for Private customers only) if sign-off delayed.
- Decide during sync: can we do a limited canary (host-limited, non-Private) vs full canary that includes Private tenants?

Post-sync follow-ups (if GO)
- Create rollout channel (#release-rollout-2026-03-05) and invite SRE, Infra, Product, Applied-ML, CS
- Schedule short 15m check-ins at +15m, +60m, +3h after rollout start
- Ops: confirm runbooks and on-call rotation for the window

Last-minute TODOs
- Grab updated regression test matrix from QA (where are flaky tags?) - ping QA lead in morning.
- Confirm that observability alert thresholds are in config repo (infra PR 1789) and backed up to S3.

---
Informal notes / scratch (things to remember)
- If autoscaler behaves, we do normal canary. If not, propose reduced traffic canary + manual validation for Private customers.
- Keep legal in the loop for release notes language; avoid customer-impact phrasing until we know rollback risk.

End of notes.
